blurb: Reunion Yoga + Pilates offers creative and thoughtful movement classes in various styles, emphasizing steady breath and mindful awareness. They provide a Pilates teacher training program based on core exercises and modern biomechanics, including anatomy, exercise cueing, and teaching skills. The training includes in-person instruction, practice teaching, and a final assessment.
